reviews.text: I walked in today with a fairly vague idea of what i wanted and miss Mary did not disappoint. The customer service as well as the service itself were absolutely incredible and I will be going back. Thank you!

Absolutely wonderful! All the stylists were so sweet, and funny. They did a wonderful job with my hair, the color came out perfectly! The women who took care of me always made sure I was comfortable, and offered me drinks and snacks.
Mandy is the BEST! I have trusted her with my brows for over 5 years. She has also done my haircuts & provides wax services. So talented & the kindest woman!
